bertopic_model_metadata.outlier_encoding_protocol: Explicit (K+1)-slot one-hot indicator (slot 0 = outlier topic -1, slots 1..36 = proper topics 0..35) + 36-dim soft HDBSCAN probability distribution + 1 max-confidence scalar (total topic feature dim = 74; classic one-hot+prob dim = 38).

protocol.encoder_freezing: PhoBERT encoder parameters frozen during CLS feature extraction
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Evaluated across all 3 PhoBERT seeds (42, 123, 2024), each selected by best validation macro-F1 on final_val.csv
protocol.classifier_training: StandardScaler + L2 LogisticRegression fitted strictly on final_train.csv (n=6,392); C selected on final_val.csv (n=1,371)
